_meta.name: Agent-in-the-Loop (Flow Calls Agent)
_meta.description: Agent flow with 'Run an agent' node: flow delegates complex reasoning to a published agent mid-flow. The agent uses its knowledge, tools, and instructions to process the request. Optional 'request human assistance when unsure'. GA Mar 2026.

placeholders.{{AGENT_SCHEMA_NAME}}: Schema name of the published agent to call
placeholders.{{INPUT_PARAM}}: Name of the input parameter from the trigger
placeholders.{{AGENT_MESSAGE}}: Message template to send to the agent (can use dynamic content)
placeholders.{{OUTPUT_PROPERTY}}: Name of the output returned to the calling flow/agent
placeholders.{{CONN_REF_LOGICAL}}: Connection reference for Copilot Studio connector

notes: The called agent must be PUBLISHED before it can be invoked
Agent uses its full capabilities (knowledge, tools, instructions) to process
Toggle 'Request human assistance when unsure' for safety-critical scenarios
This is the INVERSE of agent-flow-basic (which is agent-calls-flow)
For simple agent calls from cloud flows, use Execute Agent action instead
Agent node is only available in agent flows (not cloud flows)

{{INPUT_PARAM}}.description: Data to send to the agent for processing

metadata.notes: Agent processes the message using its knowledge, tools, and instructions. Response contains the agent's reasoning result.

body.{{OUTPUT_PROPERTY}}: The agent was unable to process this request.
